title: Wall Mount Soap Dish Solid Brass 4.5-Inch Dottingham Collection Bath Accessory | Venetian Bronze | Allied Brass
description:
Add a wall mount soap dish to keep soap handy while reducing countertop clutter in the bathroom in Venetian Bronze, which presents deep, warm undertones with subtle golden accents, evoking European craftsmanship and timeless style. This Dottingham collection soap holder / soap dish accessory is crafted from solid brass and installs with concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean look.

Highlights:
- Venetian Bronze brings rich depth and character
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for an uncluttered appearance
- Installation hardware included; easy to install
- Coordinates with the Dottingham collection for matching transitional bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories

Specs:
- Dimensions: 4.5 in L x 3.5 in W x 3 in H
- Projection: 5 in
- Weight capacity: 2 lb
- Product weight: 1.6 lb
- Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4
- Assembly required: No
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
- Multiple designer finish options available
